description.value: Codes are the values listed for the “Line item Action Flag” row of the APC Return Buffer Table in the CMS Integrated Outpatient Code Editor (I/OCE) Specifications, with meanings as given in that row’s Description column. The Line Item Action Flag is set by the Medicare Administrative Contractor (MAC) on input to the I/OCE to override, or to externally impose, line item denial, rejection, or adjustment, and is passed through to the Pricer. CMS defines and maintains the codes and publishes the specification with each quarterly I/OCE release.
